title: Orbit Telemetry

list.name: norad
list.query: SELECT norad::text FROM satellite ORDER BY norad

list.name: measure
list.label: further measures
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT measure FROM field_semantic WHERE norad = $norad AND measure IN ('signal','attitude','position','charge','memory','frequency') ORDER BY 1
list.definition: measures this satellite reports beyond the panels above

panels.title: Orbit altitude (from position cache — live for every satellite)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, alt_km AS altitude FROM position WHERE norad = $norad ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Battery voltage

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN length(field) > 40 THEN regexp_replace(field, '^.*_([^_]+_[^_]+_[^_]+_[^_]+)$', '\1') ELSE field END AS metric, value_num AS value FROM telemetry JOIN field_semantic s USING (norad, field) WHERE norad = $norad AND s.measure = 'voltage' AND value_num IS NOT NULL AND (s.lo IS NULL OR value_num BETWEEN s.lo AND s.hi) ORDER BY ts

panels.description: Fields are chosen by the semantic layer (field_semantic, #526): what this spacecraft's decoder calls them stays in the legend, what they ARE decides the panel. Values outside the measure's plausible range are left out.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (field) field, s.measure, s.unit, COALESCE(value_num::text, value_txt) AS value, ts FROM telemetry JOIN field_semantic s USING (norad, field) WHERE norad = $norad AND s.kind <> 'scaffolding' ORDER BY field, ts DESC
SELECT ts AS time, value_num AS value FROM telemetry WHERE norad = $norad AND field = 'battery_pct' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Battery vs orbital sunlight — position+telemetry fusion

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, value_num AS battery_v FROM telemetry WHERE norad = $norad AND field = 'battery_v' ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, (CASE WHEN sunlit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float AS sunlight FROM position WHERE norad = $norad AND sunlit IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, count(DISTINCT ts)::float AS frames FROM telemetry WHERE norad = $norad GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ground stations — frames received (this satellite, selected window)

targets.rawSql: SELECT split_part(observer, '-', 1) AS station, count(*) AS frames FROM reception WHERE norad = $norad AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY frames DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT count(*) AS "Frames received", count(DISTINCT observer) AS "Ground stations", max(ts) AS "Last heard" FROM reception WHERE norad = $norad AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Unclassified numeric telemetry (unknown to the semantic layer — the work queue)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN length(field) > 40 THEN regexp_replace(field, '^.*_([^_]+_[^_]+_[^_]+_[^_]+)$', '\1') ELSE field END AS metric, value_num AS value FROM telemetry JOIN field_semantic s USING (norad, field) WHERE norad = $norad AND s.kind = 'unknown' AND value_num IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

panels.description: Numeric fields the semantic layer could not name — neither frame scaffolding nor a known measure. Each is a one-line edit in field_semantics.json. Scaffolding is never plotted anywhere on this board.

panels.title: $measure
panels.description: One panel per measure this satellite actually reports (signal, attitude, position, charge, memory, frequency), repeated over the `further measures` variable — a spacecraft with no attitude data gets no attitude panel rather than an empty one (#526).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, CASE WHEN length(field) > 40 THEN regexp_replace(field, '^.*_([^_]+_[^_]+_[^_]+_[^_]+)$', '\1') ELSE field END AS metric, value_num AS value FROM telemetry JOIN field_semantic s USING (norad, field) WHERE norad = $norad AND s.measure = '$measure' AND value_num IS NOT NULL AND (s.lo IS NULL OR value_num BETWEEN s.lo AND s.hi) ORDER BY ts

target.rawSql: SELECT started AS time, coalesce(ended, now()) AS timeend, coalesce(note, 'No answer from the ' || source || ' API: the control room ran on stale data' || CASE WHEN ended IS NULL THEN ' (ongoing)' ELSE '' END) AS text, 'upstream-cut' AS tags FROM provider_outage WHERE started <= $__timeTo() AND coalesce(ended, now()) >= $__timeFrom() ORDER BY started

description: Panels pick fields through the semantic layer (field_semantic, #526): scaffolding is never plotted, each measure panel shows what this spacecraft's decoder maps to it, and further measures appear only when the satellite reports them.
